title.zh: 核裂变：反应堆怎么保持临界而不爆炸
title.en: Fission: How a Reactor Stays Critical

desc.zh: 从铀-235 结合能亏损与热中子截面出发，走过慢化碰撞、六因子临界公式、0.65% 缓发中子窗口、氙-135 碘坑与停堆余热，再到乏燃料时间尺度与 2026 年的核电前沿。
desc.en: From U-235 binding energy and thermal fission cross sections, through neutron moderation, the six-factor formula, the 0.65% delayed-neutron window, xenon-135 poisoning, and shutdown decay heat, to spent fuel horizons and nuclear power in 2026.

desc.zh: 重核比结合能低于铁峰；铀-235 裂变产生约 200 MeV 可回收热能，按质量折算约 280 万倍于标准煤。
desc.en: Heavy nuclei lie below the iron peak in binding energy per nucleon; U-235 fission yields ~200 MeV of recoverable heat, ~2.8 million times coal per kilogram.

desc.zh: 将 2 MeV 快中子慢化至 0.0253 eV 热中子，U-235 裂变截面从 1.2 b 升至 585 b；轻水只需约 20 次碰撞，重水约 36 次，石墨约 115 次。
desc.en: Slowing 2 MeV fission neutrons to 0.0253 eV raises U-235 fission cross section from 1.2 b to 585 b; water takes ~20 collisions, heavy water ~36, graphite ~115.

title.zh: 六因子临界与负空泡反馈

desc.zh: 净增殖因子 k_eff = η·f·p·ε·P_F·P_T；轻水不能烧天然铀，而水沸腾起泡压低 k_eff 使商用压水堆无法核爆。
desc.en: Net multiplication k_eff = eta*f*p*eps*P_F*P_T; natural uranium cannot go critical in light water, and boiling voids drop k_eff to throttle runaway.

zh: 为什么反应堆不会像原子弹一样爆炸
en: why reactors cannot explode like bombs

desc.zh: U-235 热裂变中 0.65% 晚到数秒至近一分钟的缓发中子把有效代时拉长上千倍，使机械控制棒追得上链式反应；1$ 以上瞬发临界靠多普勒负反馈自限幅。
desc.en: Delayed neutrons (0.65% for U-235, mean delay ~13 s) lengthen effective generation time over a thousandfold so rods keep up; Doppler broadening quenches above $1 prompt criticality.

desc.zh: 降功率或停堆后中子烧氙中断，但半衰期 6.57 h 的碘-135 继续衰变成 2.65 百万靶的氙-135，在 8–10 小时形成制约重启的负反应性深坑。
desc.en: After a power drop, neutron burnout of Xe-135 stops while 6.57 h I-135 keeps decaying into 2.65-million-barn Xe-135, deepening negative reactivity for ~8–10 hours.

desc.zh: 急停只关掉链式裂变，已积累碎片衰变在停堆 1 秒仍占 ~6% 额定热功率（3000 MWth 堆约 181 MW），1 小时后仍需持续带走数十兆瓦热。
desc.en: Scramming stops fission, not radioactive decay of accumulated fragments: at 1 s power stays ~6% (~181 MWth for a 3,000 MWth core) and requires active or passive cooling for days.

title.zh: 乏燃料成分与双时间尺度

desc.zh: 1 GWe 压水堆年卸出 ~24 吨乏燃料；裂变产物 Cs/Sr 毒性在 300 年降超两千倍，Pu/次锕系把一次通过基准线推到十万年以上。
desc.en: One 1 GWe PWR discharges ~24 tHM/yr; Cs-137/Sr-90 drop over 2,000x within 300 yr, whereas Pu/minor actinides push once-through radiotoxicity past 100,000 yr.

title.zh: 2026 核电前沿与先进堆路线

desc.zh: 对比 2026 年在运三代堆、高温气冷堆与钠冷快堆在浓集度（LEU vs HALEU）、出口温度、卡诺效率上限与规模经济上的现实权衡。
desc.en: As-of-2026 fleet status alongside physical tradeoffs across Gen III+ PWR, CANDU, HTGR, and sodium fast reactors: enrichment, outlet temperature, Carnot ceiling, and HALEU/cost bottlenecks.
